matches.preview: The model sees this as finely balanced, with Wolverhampton Wanderers narrowly favoured at 38%. Birmingham City have a 33% win probability, while the draw is rated at 29%. Birmingham ended last season strongly at home, winning three successive listed matches there, including two 2-1 victories and a 2-0 success. Wolves finished their top-flight campaign without a win in the six results supplied, although three of those matches ended 1-1. The historical meetings also favour Wolves, who won three of the five listed encounters. The total-goals forecast leans under 2.5 goals at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型認為本場比賽雙方勢均力敵，Wolverhampton Wanderers以38%的勝率略占優勢。Birmingham City的勝率為33%，平局機率則為29%。Birmingham上賽季末段在主場表現強勢，於列出的比賽中取得三連勝，包括兩場以2：1獲勝，以及一場以2：0取勝。Wolves在頂級聯賽賽季的最後六場列出賽果中未嘗勝績，不過其中三場以1：1結束。歷史交手紀錄同樣較有利於Wolves，他們在列出的五次對決中贏得三場。總進球數預測顯示，少於2．5球的機率為54%。

matches.preview: Sheffield United are the model’s measured favourites, with a 41% chance of an away win, compared with 31% for Blackburn Rovers and 28% for the draw. Blackburn won 3-1 at Sheffield United in April, although the five recent meetings have produced two victories for each side and one draw. At the end of last season, Blackburn took six points from their final six matches, while Sheffield United collected nine and won two of their last three away games. The total-goals assessment offers no clear direction: over 2.5 and under 2.5 are both rated at exactly 50%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型評估認為 Sheffield United 略占優勢，客場獲勝機率為41%，Blackburn Rovers 獲勝機率為31%，平手機率則為28%。Blackburn 在今年4月客場以3：1擊敗 Sheffield United，不過雙方近五次交手各贏兩場，另有一場平手。上賽季末，Blackburn 在最後六場比賽拿下六分，Sheffield United 則取得九分，並在最後三場客場比賽中贏得兩場。總進球數評估沒有明確傾向，超過2.5球與低於2.5球的機率均恰好為50%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 sees this as finely balanced, with Wrexham AFC given a slight edge at 41%, ahead of Burnley at 33%, while the draw stands at 27%. Wrexham’s closing Championship run last season was mixed. They beat Oxford and Stoke without conceding, but also suffered heavy defeats against Coventry and Southampton before drawing 2-2 with Middlesbrough. Burnley’s final six Premier League matches brought draws with Wolves and Aston Villa alongside four defeats. With no previous meetings on record, there is no head-to-head pattern to add. The total-goals lean is over 2.5 at 56%, compared with under 2.5 at 44%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90認為本場勝負相當接近，Wrexham AFC以41%略占優勢，Burnley為33%，和局則為27%。Wrexham上季在英格蘭冠軍足球聯賽收官階段的表現有好有壞。他們擊敗Oxford與Stoke，且均未失球，但也曾大比分敗給Coventry與Southampton，之後以2比2與Middlesbrough握手言和。Burnley在英格蘭超級足球聯賽最後六場比賽中，分別與Wolves及Aston Villa踢成平手，另外四場則吞下敗仗。雙方過去沒有交手紀錄，因此沒有對戰趨勢可供參考。總進球數方面，達到3球以上的可能性為56%，2球以下則為44%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 makes Cardiff City the narrow favourite at 43%, with Stoke City at 30% and the draw at 27%. Cardiff’s listed Championship results date from 2025, so they are history as the club returns to this level. That sequence contained three draws and three defeats. Stoke’s six listed 2026 matches brought one draw and five defeats, with three games in which they failed to score. The latest meeting ended in a 1-0 Stoke win, while three of the previous four meetings were drawn. The total-goals forecast leans slightly towards over 2.5 at 54%, compared with 46% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90稍微看好 Cardiff City，預測其獲勝機率為43%，Stoke City 為30%，平手為27%。Cardiff City 列出的英格蘭冠軍足球聯賽賽果均來自2025年，因此隨著球隊重返此級別，這些紀錄已成過往。該段賽程包含三場平手及三場敗仗。Stoke City 列出的六場2026年比賽則取得一場平手及五場敗仗，其中三場未能進球。兩隊最近一次交手由 Stoke City 以1比0獲勝，而此前四次交手中有三場戰成平手。總進球數預測略微傾向三球以上，機率為54%，兩球以下則為46%。

matches.preview: The model favours a Watford win at 45%, with both the draw and a Preston North End win at 27%. Watford ended last season with five consecutive defeats, failing to score in four of them, while Preston recorded two away wins across their final three trips. Recent meetings offer Preston some encouragement: Watford have not won any of the last five encounters, although the two most recent finished level, 2-2 and 1-1. Overall, the home side has a measured advantage in what remains a competitive forecast. The total-goals assessment is almost even, with under 2.5 goals narrowly preferred at 51% to over 2.5 at 49%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型預測 Watford 獲勝的機率為45%，平局與 Preston North End 獲勝的機率均為27%。Watford 上賽季以五連敗收尾，其中四場未能進球；Preston 則在最後三場客場賽事中贏得兩場。近期交手紀錄為 Preston 帶來一些信心：Watford 在最近五次交鋒中皆未獲勝，不過最近兩場分別以2比2及1比1戰平。整體而言，這場實力接近的比賽中，主隊略占優勢。總進球數的預測幾乎持平，少於2.5球的機率為51%，略高於多於2.5球的49%。

matches.preview: The model favours Southampton, but only moderately, with a 52% home-win probability. The draw is rated at 26% and a Swansea City win at 23%, so the visitors retain a meaningful chance. Southampton ended last season with four wins and two draws from their final six listed matches, scoring at least twice in each. Swansea also finished steadily, with three wins and two draws across their last six. Southampton won 2-1 at Swansea in April and are unbeaten in the five recent meetings supplied. The total-goals forecast is nearly even, with a slight lean towards over 2.5 goals at 51%, compared with 49% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: 模型較看好 Southampton，但優勢僅屬中等，主場獲勝機率為52%。平局機率為26%，Swansea City 獲勝機率為23%，因此客隊仍有相當的取勝機會。Southampton 上賽季最後列出的六場比賽取得四勝兩和，每場至少攻進兩球。Swansea 同樣以穩定表現結束賽季，最近六場取得三勝兩和。Southampton 四月作客 Swansea 時以2比1獲勝，並且在所提供的近五次交手中保持不敗。全場總進球數預測相當接近，至少三球的機率略高，為51%，不超過兩球的機率則為49%。

matches.preview: The model makes West Ham United clear favourites, giving the visitors a 59% chance of winning, compared with 24% for the draw and 18% for a Bolton Wanderers victory. West Ham ended last season with two wins, three defeats and one draw across their final six matches, including a 3-0 home win over Leeds. Bolton’s listed results date from 2019, before their spell outside the top two English divisions, so they are history rather than current form as the club returns to this level. There are no previous meetings on record. The total-goals lean is over 2.5 at 57%, with under 2.5 at 43%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明顯看好 West Ham United，認為客隊有 59% 的獲勝機率，相較之下，平局機率為 24%，Bolton Wanderers 獲勝的機率則為 18%。West Ham United 上季最後六場比賽取得兩勝三負一和，其中包括主場以三比零擊敗 Leeds。Bolton Wanderers 所列出的比賽結果可追溯至 2019 年，當時球隊尚未經歷離開英格蘭前兩級聯賽的那段時期，因此隨著俱樂部重返這個級別，這些結果只能視為歷史紀錄，而非近期狀態。雙方過去沒有交手紀錄。總進球數方面，超過 2.5 球的機率為 57%，低於 2.5 球的機率為 43%。

matches.preview: The model favours Norwich City, but only moderately, assigning the home side a 45% win probability. The draw is rated at 27%, with a Birmingham City win at 28%, so there is still meaningful uncertainty around the result. Norwich ended last season with three wins in six listed Championship matches, including a 4-2 victory away at Bristol City, while Birmingham finished that sequence with three wins and two draws. The recent head-to-head record favours the visitors, who won the latest three meetings, most recently 2-1 at Norwich in February. On total goals, the lean is narrowly towards over 2.5 at 51%, compared with under 2.5 at 49%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型較看好 Norwich City，但優勢有限，認為主隊的勝率為45%。和局機率為27%，Birmingham City 獲勝的機率為28%，因此比賽結果仍有相當大的不確定性。Norwich 在上季最後六場列出的 Championship 賽事中取得三勝，包括作客以4比2擊敗 Bristol City；Birmingham 則在該段賽程中取得三勝兩和。近期對戰紀錄有利於客隊，他們在最近三次交手中全數獲勝，最近一次是在2月作客 Norwich 以2比1取勝。總進球方面，超過2.5球的機率略高，為51%，低於2.5球則為49%。

matches.preview: Oracle90 rates this match as finely balanced, with Derby County and West Bromwich Albion both given a 36% chance of winning, while the draw stands at 28%. Derby’s listed results from the end of last season were mixed, with three wins and three defeats across their final six matches. West Brom finished that campaign with three clean sheets in six games, including consecutive 0-0 draws, before losing at Sheffield Wednesday. Derby have also avoided defeat in the five recent meetings supplied, winning four and drawing one. The total-goals lean is narrow, with under 2.5 goals at 51% and over 2.5 at 49%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 評估本場比賽實力相當接近，Derby County 與 West Bromwich Albion 的獲勝機率均為36%，平局機率則為28%。Derby County 在上季末所列的戰績有好有壞，最後六場比賽取得三勝三敗。West Bromwich Albion 在該賽季末六場比賽中有三場零封對手，其中包括連續兩場以0比0戰平，之後則敗給Sheffield Wednesday。根據所提供的近期五次交手紀錄，Derby County 也保持不敗，取得四勝一平。總進球數的預測差距很小，低於2.5球的機率為51%，高於2.5球的機率為49%。

matches.preview: The model sees a finely balanced match, with Queens Park Rangers holding a narrow edge at 39%. Charlton Athletic are rated at 33%, while the draw stands at 28%. Both sides arrive after difficult finishes to last season. Charlton won once in their final six Championship matches, while QPR lost their final four, including a 3-0 defeat at Ipswich. The latest meeting ended 0-0 in February, although QPR won the previous encounter 3-1. A tight contest is expected, with under 2.5 goals narrowly favoured at 53%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型認為這是一場勢均力敵的比賽，Queens Park Rangers以39%的勝率稍占優勢，Charlton Athletic的勝率為33%，平局機率則為28%。兩隊上賽季收官階段的表現都不理想。Charlton在最後六場英冠比賽中僅贏一場，QPR則在最後四場比賽全數落敗，其中包括以0比3不敵Ipswich。雙方最近一次交手於二月以0比0收場，不過QPR在前一次對決中以3比1獲勝。預計比賽將相當膠著，總進球數低於2.5球的機率略高，為53%。
